groups.problem: NewMetricsMiddleware reuses a shared middleware instance and overwrites its next delegate on each decoration.
groups.rationale: Both suggestions identify the same captured imw instance and mutable imw.next assignment, and propose creating a separate instance per decoration.

groups.problem: Middleware request handlers dereference potentially nil requests without guards.
groups.rationale: S9 and S2 report identical missing guards in ContextualLoggerMiddleware; S8 reports the same repeated mistake in the corresponding MetricsMiddleware handlers. Each affected handler needs the same early-return guard before accessing request fields.
